## Summary

Describe the user or engineering outcome and why this change is needed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The scoped behavior is complete.
- [ ] Relevant tests cover the change.
- [ ] Lint, type-check, tests, and build pass.
- [ ] Security, tenancy, accessibility, and localization impacts were reviewed.
- [ ] Documentation or ADRs were updated when needed.

## Evidence

List commands run, test results, and screenshots or preview links when UI changed.

## Risks

Call out remaining limitations, migrations, rollout concerns, or follow-up decisions.
